review:
Feudal Japan on Stackways, with up to 100,000 ways. Normal Stackways symbols fill a reel with 2 to 4 identical symbols; revealing ones stack 5 to 10 high – but only when that makes a win.

Three FS start Stack Spins: 10 free spins with more Stackways symbols. The surprise is the rating: 2/5, one of Hacksaw's gentlest games, with a 5,000x max and 96.35% top RTP. A great introduction if Hacksaw usually feels too harsh.
